Varies (Captain Atom's power levels vary greatly, and he has complete control over the output of his power levels. He can power himself down and up at will. In addition, he is mentally and emotionally somewhat unstable, which also tend to mess with his powers. Furthermore, his unstable physical form causes fluctuations in his power levels from time to time. And he can control how much power to draw from the Quantum Field). Solar System level (In an alternate vision, a Quantum-powered gorrila was able to overpower the Justice League. This was a vision shown to future Captain Atom who saw potentially different possibilities and how his powers could have been used differently. A burst of quantum flare proved too much for Hal Jordan to contain with his shield and left a portion of the city destroyed. Captain Atom has access to the infinite energies of the Quantum Field), higher in Evolved Form (However, it was hinted that in some ways, he might be superior to his former, unstable self.The Fall and Rise of Captain Atom Vol 1 3 Captain Atom has access to the infinite energies of the Quantum Field), up to High Complex Multiverse level with Absorption (Absorbed his future selves, who were far more potent than him, and fought his universe-destroying self for a brief period of time, before the latter was erased from history) and in Unrestricted State (If he were to stop holding back, give up on his humanity, and embrace his true power, he can become a space-time eating energy monster)

Massively FTL+ usually (Can keep up with the Flash and had a long conversation in a fraction of a microsecond where everything was frozen. Perceives time at a much slower rate), higher in astral form (Caught up to Dr Megala's astral form who crossed interstellar distances in an extremely short period of time. Outpaced the expansion of energy and matter from the big bang. Kept up with the Big Bang as the universe was being created)

Varies. Solar System level, higher in Evolved Form (Can take attacks from those whom he can harm. Casually tanked a 100-kiloton bomb), up to High Complex Multiverse level with absorption (Survived a few hits from his universe-destroying future self) and in Unrestricted State
Infinite. Never seems to run out of stamina. In addition, he is very closely connected to the Quantum Field, so he can draw upon its infinite energies.
Up to Planetary with energy attacks, Interdimensional with dimensional travel
None notable

Genius. Nathaniel was never a smart person, but after acquiring his power, he had no choice but to learn more about the field of science, otherwise he would have not been able to use his powers in a proper manner. He needed to learn how matter and energy works so he can use his powers efficiently. When healing the cancer of Ratina, he followed the instructions of Dr Megala perfectly to the point where he was able to create tissues and proteins. Was able to outsmart an angry Dr. Megala, albeit in a very small way. Was able to deduce how Megala was controlling Firestorm in a matter of seconds.

Constantly shifting energies and molecules can weaken him momentarily as he cannot adjust to the ever-changing pattern. However, he was able to overcome these obstacles very quickly. Absorbing too much energy or radiation has bad side-effects on his body. In addition, absorbing too much leaves him weak for a short period of time. Captain Atom has too much power, so he tried to help people by being a miracle worker, however, that created a chain reaction which led him to reaching his full potential and was going to destroy the entirety of the time-space continuum. Therefore, he avoids helping people and using too much power in fear of becoming a God again. Radiated bullets can temporarily nullify his Quantum aura. Notable Attacks/Techniques *Hold back: Captain Atom holds back for a variety of reasons, be it his internal conflict, or his fear of becoming a God again. In addition, if he doesn't hold back, he could bring about the death of countless people. *Matter and energy over fists: Captain Atom rarely ever fights physically, as he has no need for it. Instead, he fights by using his energy and matter-related powers as they do the job much better. *Absorption: When faced with attacks, Captain Atom will try to absorb as much as of it as he can, so the damage to the people and environment around him is minimized. In addition, he can draw upon those powers to enhance his own abilities. Notes: *This only covers Captain Atom from the Post-Flashpoint timeline, and not his Post-Crisis incarnation or the original incarnation of the character from Charlton Comics. *Quantum-powered individuals in this continuity share similar physical characteristics, as well as similar abilities and weaknesses. Therefore, some of these abilities and weaknesses, such as absorption, are interchangeable. *Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses: Inconclusive: ==References== {{Scroll box|{{reflist|2}}}} {{Discussions|Captain Atom|Captain Atom (Post-Flashpoint)}} Category:Characters Category:DC Comics Category:Absorption Users Category:Adaptation Users Category:Astral Projection Users Category:Biology Users Category:Comic Book Characters Category:Cosmic Devourers Category:Data Users Category:Dimensional Travel Users Category:Disease Users Category:Duplication Users Category:Energy Projection Users Category:Energy Users Category:Enhanced Senses Users Category:Fire Users Category:Flight Users Category:Forcefield Users Category:Fusionism Users Category:Geniuses Category:Immortals Category:Inorganic Beings Category:Justice League Members Category:Large Sized Characters Category:Life Users Category:Matter Users Category:Non-Physical Interaction Users Category:Post-Flashpoint Category:Protagonists Category:Regeneration Users Category:Self-Destruction Users Category:Self-Sustenance Users Category:Small Sized Characters Category:Space Users Category:Statistics Amplification Users Category:Subjective Reality Users Category:Superheroes Category:Technology Users Category:Teleportation Users Category:Time Travelers Category:Time Users Category:Transformation Users Category:Transmutation Users Category:Vibration Users

Solar System level (He is comparable to other high-tier DC Comics superheroes) | Universe level+ (Can cause a new Big Bang, created a universe within the Quantum Field and later destroyed it. Defeated Nekron) | Universe level+ (Stronger than an Unrestricted Atom. Easily defeated the Captain Atom Brigade, a team composed by multiple versions of Atom, before absorbing them. Massively FTL+ | Massively FTL+ | Massively FTL+ (Could keep up with an amplified Superboy-Prime)
Solar System level | Universe level+ | Universe level+

If Atom absorbs too much energy at once, he will be sent hurtling through time. Depending on the type of energy absorbed, he either goes forward or backwards | If his Armor get breached it can accidentaly release enough energy to destroy an entire Universal space-time continuum Notable Attacks/Techniques * Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, space, and matter at will, which he is able to use to defeat beings as powerful as Nekron. * Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished. * Dilustel Armor: Captain Atom's metallic shell, or "skin", is composed of a portion of the alien being known as Silver Shield, and is called Dilustel. Pieces of the alien's metal body were used in the Captain Atom Project, Project Major Force and similar projects thereafter. Nathaniel is able to coat himself with the metal, either partially or totally. Atom's symbiosis with the metal is such that even partially armored, he is able to access the Quantum Field. * Quantum Field Manipulation: Captain Atom's metal skin is tied into the Quantum Field, which enables him to absorb and manipulate incredible amounts of energy for a wide variety of applications. As a result, he is able to create an exact replica of Earth, complete with life, with a thought, as well as duplicates of Superman, Flash, Firestorm and even the Spectre with ease. His power is such, that he went even further, and by simply thinking of it, he was able to instantaneously create an entire universe out of nothing, and just as easily destroyed an entire universe, but he has never used this level of power again as a result of him mentally limiting himself. Captain Atom is also able to absorb potentially harmful energy into himself, but absorbing too much can overload him and send him hurtling through time. Captain Atom can fire and control energy of any form. He commonly manipulates his energy into forcefield bubbles, or explosive 'bombs', as well as simple blasts of kinetic force. While he usually aims with his hands, he is able to emit energy from any point on his body. Several times he has "detonated", releasing a massive amount of energy at once, destroying objects within an certain radius. On more than one occasion, he has used his ability to manipulate all forms of energy to prevent a foe using their own powers, such as the Ray and Firestorm.

Mountain level (Was able to fight evenly with Superman and managed to harm him) 103.64 Megatons of TNT
Supersonic flight speed (Can fly at speeds of Mach 2. Can keep up with the likes of Superman) with Relativistic combat and reaction speed (Can react to Superman's attacks)
Mountain level (Can tank multiple hits from Superman)
Superhuman (Can take multiple hits from Superman and continue to fight him for an extended period of time)
Standard Melee Range, Tens of Meters via powers, much higher via exploding
His Containment Suit
Gifted. He is an experienced Air Force member with years of experience, which also makes him a good tactician. He has excellent mastery over his powers and knows how to use them in versatile ways.

The amount of energy he can absorb is limited and he sometimes have trouble absorbing high amounts of energy. Atom's symbiosis with the metal is such that even partially armored, he is able to access the Quantum Field. * Quantum Field Manipulation: Captain Atom's metal skin is tied into the Quantum Field, which enables him to absorb and manipulate incredible amounts of energy for a wide variety of applications. As a result, he is able to create an exact replica of Earth, complete with life, with a thought, as well as duplicates of Superman, Flash, Firestorm and even the Spectre with ease. His power is such, that he went even further, and by simply thinking of it, he was able to instantaneously create an entire universe out of nothing, and just as easily destroyed an entire universe, but he has never used this level of power again as a result of him mentally limiting himself. Captain Atom is also able to absorb potentially harmful energy into himself, but absorbing too much can overload him and send him hurtling through time. Captain Atom can fire and control energy of any form. He commonly manipulates his energy into forcefield bubbles, or explosive 'bombs', as well as simple blasts of kinetic force. While he usually aims with his hands, he is able to emit energy from any point on his body. Several times he has "detonated", releasing a massive amount of energy at once, destroying objects within an certain radius. On more than one occasion, he has used his ability to manipulate all forms of energy to prevent a foe using their own powers, such as the Ray and Firestorm.
